findings.note: This January 2026 Flyers piece says Dvorak was centering top scorers Trevor Zegras and Travis Konecny and was third on the team in scoring. It is about last season, though, and does not confirm his line or power-play role for the 2026-27 season or for tonight.
Dvorak had 25 points in his first 39 games of 2025-26, which beat his usual pace. Before that he was around 33 points per 82 games, so the stronger stretch could turn out to be temporary.

This July 2025 profile describes Dvorak as mainly a third-line, defense-first center and penalty killer who has mostly played on the second power-play unit. It also says he has had injuries in recent seasons, though he played all 82 games in 2024-25.
